name: Silk Cotton Flare
subtitle: Flame-Red Hoa Gao
mechanism: Aura (AuraPlant). Every pulse_interval s: a gliding Paper Effigy within aura_radius is forced to land (PaperEffigy.knock_down) and takes ignite_damage; every grounded enemy within aura_radius takes burn_damage.

abilities.name: Ember Shower
abilities.trigger: Every 0.5 s while enemies are near
abilities.effect: Grounds gliders within 6 m (20 damage as the paper catches fire); 3 damage to other enemies in range.

clipAnnotations.idle: Flowers pulse; the bare tree sways.
clipAnnotations.attack: A shiver, then every flower flares open.
clipAnnotations.die: Squash and shrink into the lawn.
